{{Quote|Why would he go to the Ploo Sector?|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="TF">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ploo sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It included the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Ploo II/Legends|Ploo II]], [[Ploo IV/Legends|Ploo IV]], [[Plooriod III]], [[Plooriod IV]] and [[Serroco]]. It also contained a part of the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]].

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Ploo [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was among the first sectors to throw off the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="RECG" />
